review_notes: I read the whole file and searched Mathlib for related declarations. The file defines `mkDerivationₗ`, `mkDerivation` and `mkDerivationEquiv` for `MvPolynomial`. The only similar declarations are `Polynomial.mkDerivation` and `Polynomial.mkDerivationEquiv` in Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Derivation.lean. Those are for a different type, namely one-variable polynomials, and they are parallel specialisations. They are not competing versions of one concept. `MvPolynomial.pderiv` in PDeriv.lean is built from `mkDerivation`, so it uses this API instead of duplicating it. `mkDerivationₗ` is documented as an internal linear-map step and is used to build `mkDerivation`. I found no independent existing Mathlib concept that these declarations duplicate. I did not check Batteries or core, since `Derivation` and `MvPolynomial` are Mathlib concepts.
